findings.title: Apply the moved-session guard to in-process resume paths
findings.body: TARGET-UPSTREAM defect (new session-transfer feature): after `omp session moved` records a `departed` marker, startup resume invokes this guard, but an already-running TUI's selector (`src/modes/controllers/selector-controller.ts:1914`), RPC switch (`src/modes/rpc/rpc-mode.ts:877`), and ACP load (`src/modes/acp/acp-agent.ts:1323`) call `AgentSession.switchSession` directly. That method adopts the original file at `src/session/agent-session.ts:11480`, and `SessionManager.#setSessionFile` at 2290–2384 neither recognizes the marker nor forks. Consequently the supposedly stale source continues writing under its original session identity instead of creating the promised fork, allowing the two machines' histories to diverge under one ID. Move the departed-session adoption check into the authoritative switch/adoption boundary while preserving rollback and lifecycle cancellation; keep raw read-only opens available for transfer operations. A discriminating probe should mark a synthetic session departed, resume it through both startup and in-process switch, and require a new ID/path with the source file unchanged in both cases.

findings.title: Preserve existing Hindsight snapshots when adopting upstream recall storage
findings.body: MIGRATION loss, not a new pristine-upstream regression: 18.10's new `findPersistedRecall` reader accepts only `customType: "memory_recall"` with `{version:1, scope, text, memories}` (`src/memory-backend/recall-entry.ts:106–145`), whereas the fully replayed 18.7 baseline writes `hindsight_recall_snippet` with `{snippet}` and separately freezes `hindsight_mental_models_snippet` (`src/hindsight/state.ts:34–43`). On the first resume of an existing baseline session the new reader silently skips its committed snapshot and performs fresh recall, including when the old committed answer was empty; changed bank contents then change the system prefix. Upstream also retains live mental-model reloads (`state.ts:508–595`) and the unpatched promotion carrier, so its new recall persistence is not grounds to retire family-hindsight. Rebase that family with an explicit old-record migration preserving exact text/empty answers and reset boundaries, retain the frozen mental-model and single trailing promotion-slot behavior, and preserve upstream scope isolation rather than globally treating legacy records as arbitrary-scope matches. One actual-reader probe with a completed legacy transcript, changed recall results, and empty/nonempty snapshots should demonstrate identical pre/post-upgrade system-block arrays without a fresh automatic recall.

explanation:
The migration is not ready for approval: the audit found one new upstream session-transfer routing defect and a concrete loss of existing Hindsight recall snapshots, while the current dirty extension edits themselves showed no newly introduced functional defect.

Evidence roots: B = /tmp/omp-18100-audit-cd9kqmcj/pristine-18.7.0/node_modules/@oh-my-pi; P = /tmp/omp-18100-audit-cd9kqmcj/replay-18.7.0/node_modules/@oh-my-pi; U = /tmp/omp-18100-audit-cd9kqmcj/pristine-18.10.0/node_modules/@oh-my-pi; paths below relative to pi-coding-agent unless another package is named

OWNED FAMILY MATRIX — stable IDs for parent integration
• family-hindsight: REBASE; retain exact persisted recall including empty answers, frozen mental-model snapshots, generation-owned transition publication, reset-boundary lookup, and exactly one trailing recall promotion block; upstream adds memory_recall persistence but not equivalent storage or promotion/MM behavior; U src/hindsight/state.ts:448–489 and src/memory-backend/recall-entry.ts:106–145 versus P src/hindsight/state.ts:34–43; B→U src/session/session-memory.ts has no changes, so local promotion-tail protection is not upstreamed; acceptance: old completed transcripts resume with identical ordered system blocks, target-session snapshots replace source-session snapshots, reset cannot reuse pre-boundary recall, and a failed/cancelled transition cannot publish source/losing data; do not retire on upstream's new persistence alone
• 0010-omp-extension-idle-ephemeral-turn: REBASE; retain synchronous reservation, admission/transition gates, abort-and-settle before main dispatch, generation rechecks, epoch-safe finalization, disposal cancellation, and host/declaration closure; P src/session/agent-session.ts:11011–11060 implements the reservation and 5315–5334 combines idle cancellation with translator lifecycle cancellation; U retains only raw concurrent runEphemeralTurn at 11097, with new parentSessionId request-control inheritance and side-provider-state release that must survive rebasing; U context action hosts at src/modes/runtime-init.ts:148–150, modes/acp/acp-agent.ts:2629–2631, and both extension-ui-controller constructors at 238–240/466–468 still lack the guarded method; acceptance: a pending idle transport aborts and settles before a main dispatch, a reset invalidates waiting setup, and no stale finalizer decrements the replacement epoch; preserve the P Devin conversationId special case at 11037–11042 when integrating family-devin-wire, rather than replacing the entire side-options block
• 0032-omp-goal-tool-resident: RETAIN; textual replay is clean but this is not retirement evidence; U src/sdk.ts:4016 still removes goal initially, tools/index.ts:735–738 still gates it on runtime goal state, and modes/interactive-mode.ts:4879/5166/6184 still removes it from restoration snapshots; keep the resident active-set and allowlist changes together; acceptance: with goal.enabled and no restricted tool roster, absent→interview→active→paused/completed/dropped transitions retain one unchanged goal definition, while restricted subagent rosters still exclude it
• family-input-translation: REBASE; retain prepare_user_input v1, acknowledged appendEntryPersisted, cancellation-before-transition and append drain, canonical translated content versus original displayText, queue restoration, exporter/UI/declaration closure, and native summary options; U extension types lack the preparation capability/action and user-message types lack displayText; current plugin intentionally refuses activation without them at patches/input-translator-extension.ts:673–678; producer/consumer trace in P: runner.ts:1957–1991 chains results, input-controller.ts:1004–1028 consumes cancel/modelText, and 2075–2113 preserves prepared/display metadata through compaction queues without reinterpreting translated text as commands; acceptance: successful translation is durably committed before main admission, cancelled/failed preparation restores the draft without raw send, Enter and Ctrl+Enter preserve original display/canonical wire text, and transition during flush admits no stale input; do not revert upstream's new shared getMessageFromEntry helper in pi-agent-core/src/compaction/messages.ts:298–318 while restoring display-only field stripping
• 0095-omp-context-audit-request-purpose: REBASE; retain the turn/side-request distinction through SDK→runner→ContextEvent and declarations; P src/session/agent-session.ts:2068 labels provider-boundary conversions as side requests and patches/context-persist-audit-extension.ts:292–294 explicitly consumes the value; U sdk.ts:4156–4158 and extensions/runner.ts:1989–2015 omit it; preserve U history-index bookkeeping surrounding context transforms rather than replaying an older loop wholesale; acceptance: an auxiliary partial/virtual context is skipped by persistence diagnostics while a real turn with a missing persisted developer reminder is still reported

CURRENT EXTENSIONS / CORRECTED AUDIT SEMANTICS
• Preserve dirty patches/cache-prefix-audit-extension.ts changes: load-time legacy sample stripping at 403–407, new length-only samples at 484–487, and hash/length rewrite details at 786–789 remove excerpts without removing content hashes; already-existing log files are not retroactively scrubbed by these edits
• Preserve dirty patches/input-translator-extension.ts:65 default deepseek/deepseek-flash; verified the B pi-catalog/src/models.json row exists and exposes effort [low, high, max], so absence in pi-ai's source is not a missing-model defect; configured authentication remains environment-dependent and was not inspected
• Actual keepalive implementation is patches/cron-extension.ts, not a file named session-cache-keepalive-extension; line 315 consumes ctx.runIdleEphemeralTurn, budget is decremented immediately before guarded invocation at 312–315, busy preflight preserves it, lifecycle disable handlers are at 562–564; /cron keep uses the host warmer through 578–579 and still depends on retained 0092 rather than requiring a duplicate extension request
• Existing cache audit baseline is session plus payload model only, not request purpose/provider lineage: patches/cache-prefix-audit-extension.ts:875–884 compares the latest same-model request and stores one same-model diff slot; 972–995 later associates main message_end usage with that mutable slot and claims MISS CAUSED BY; U's new concurrent title fork at src/session/agent-session.ts:9411–9422 makes same-model virtual-tail traffic particularly relevant, but this diagnostic weakness predates the dirty patch and is not proof of a new wire regression
• Recommended audit semantics: carry explicit request ID, provider/wire-model, stable session/conversation lineage and request purpose through request/response observations; compare chronological predecessors within the intended lineage and correlate usage by request ID; retain cross-lane/shared-prefix and older-candidate comparisons only as annotations, never let a best-matching old request erase a real rollback; do not put system/tools hashes into the baseline key, since that would hide the drift under investigation; without request correlation, downgrade causality wording to observed mismatch plus uncorrelated usage; 0095's context purpose does not currently add purpose to before_provider_request
• Main/side prefix consistency: U pi-agent-core/src/agent.ts:910–943 builds side context from the live system prompt, model-specific tool roster, normalizeTools, owned-dialect tool omission, provider transforms and inactive tool definitions; U agent-session.ts:11130–11210 preserves this unless tools:false is explicitly requested; advisors intentionally have a different system prompt/tool roster and provider identity at U session-advisors.ts:1312–1368, so comparing an advisor request with main solely because model IDs match is not evidence of a schema bug
• Extension ordering: U extensions/loader.ts:486–509 imports concurrently but binds factories sequentially in supplied order; reject the proposed false positive that parallel module import itself reorders registration; startup injection remains an observable prefix input, with runtime-init.ts:212 awaiting session_start and sdk.ts:4747 onward accommodating late tool registrations, so migrations should compare actual post-startup tool/system arrays rather than only static registry names
• Retry/eval interaction: P turn-recovery.ts:2905–2913 appends the same developer reminder to live state and SessionManager, whereas U paths at 641/712/1089/1184 still append only to agent state; this is loss of family-persistent-prefix-resume protection, not a new 18.10 regression; P agent-session.ts:6626–6665 persists append-only eval-state-context snapshots and deduplicates the newest equal snapshot; preserve these protections and use 0095 only to suppress auxiliary-request false positives, never to exempt real-turn developer reminders
• Transfer event routing: U session-transfer.ts:177–180 persists transfer notices as custom_message; U session-context.ts:406–416 and pi-agent-core/src/compaction/messages.ts:303–312 correctly route them into context; no silent drop here; transfer intentionally changes cwd/identity and appends a notice, so identical whole-request bytes after transfer are not a legitimate acceptance requirement

MINIMAL DISCRIMINATING SMOKES FOR PARENT
• Highest value: one synthetic completed legacy Hindsight transcript covering empty/nonempty recall plus a reset boundary, consumed by actual snapshot readers and system-prompt construction, with changed remote-return fixtures to prove replay rather than accidental equality
• New-upstream defect: one departed synthetic session resumed via startup and via actual switchSession, requiring a forked ID/path and byte-unchanged source in both cases
• After family rebase: one deferred idle transport plus deferred preparation append crossing reset/main admission, asserting cancellation, settlement-before-dispatch and no stale write/admission; augment the existing focused gates rather than adding a broad suite
• If diagnostic repair is approved: feed two overlapping same-model main/title requests through actual audit handlers and complete them out of order, requiring request-correct usage attribution without labeling the virtual tail a main-history regression

No edits, builds, tests, provider requests or private session/credential reads were performed; the three exact required policy grep checks matched, and the parent's 24/24 baseline versus 3/24 partial target replay and CLI smoke results are parent-provided evidence, not execution by this reviewer.
